camel_example: aliyun live CreateRtcAsrTask --region cn-hangzhou --CallbackURL 'http://xxx.com' --Language cn --Mode live --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Creates a real-time subtitle task to transcribe an audio stream into text in real time
description_zh: 创建一个新的实时字幕任务，用于实时转录音频流为文本
kebab_example: aliyun live create-rtc-asr-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-mode live --biz-language cn --callback-url http://xxx.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRtcAsrTask

parameters.help_en: The stream mode. Valid values: live and rtc. The value live indicates a standard live stream such as RTMP
parameters.help_zh: 流模式，live或者rtc。live为正常直播流如rtmp
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication application ID.
This parameter is required when Mode is set to rtc. Otherwise, this parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
ARTC应用ID。
当参数Mode取值为rtc时，此参数必填，否则不生效
parameters.name: sdk_app_id

parameters.help_en:
The channel ID.
This parameter is required when Mode is set to rtc. Otherwise, this parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
房间号。
参数Mode取值为rtc时，此参数必填，否则不生效
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en:
The stream ingest user ID.
This parameter is required when Mode is set to rtc. Only one value can be specified. Otherwise, this parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
推流用户ID。
参数Mode取值为rtc时，此参数必填，且只能填写一个，否则不生效
parameters.name: rtc_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The streaming URL.
This parameter is required when Mode is set to live. Otherwise, this parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
直播流地址。
参数Mode取值为live时，此参数必填，否则不生效
parameters.name: stream_url

parameters.help_en:
The language of the source audio. Valid values:
ja: Japanese.
yue: Cantonese.
fspk: Chinese-English free speech.
en: English.
cn: Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
原音频语言，取值：
日语：ja。
粤语：yue。
中英文自由说：fspk。
英文：en。
中文：cn
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en:
The authentication key used to generate the MD5 signature for callback information.
Two authentication fields are added to the request header during callback: "SIG-TIME" indicates the current timestamp, and "ASR-SIG" indicates the MD5 authentication field. The "ASR-SIG" field is generated by the rule md5(`${SIG-TIME}/${callbackurl}/${authKey}`)
parameters.help_zh:
校验AuthKey，用于生成回调信息的MD5签名。
回调时会在请求头中加两个鉴权字段，"SIG-TIME"表示当前时间戳，"ASR-SIG"表示md5鉴权字段，"ASR-SIG"字段的生成规则为md5(`${SIG-TIME}/${callbackurl}/${authKey}`)
parameters.name: auth_key

parameters.help_en:
The target translation language. Valid values:
cn: Chinese.
en: English.
ja: Japanese
parameters.help_zh:
目标翻译语种，取值：
中文：cn。
英文：en。
日文：ja
parameters.name: target_languages

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically close the task when the stream disconnection exceeds the maximum delay. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 断流最大延迟，超过则自动关闭任务。默认值：false
parameters.name: auto_terminate_enabled

parameters.help_en: The automatic stream disconnection delay, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 自动断流延时，单位秒，取值：1~10秒
parameters.name: auto_terminate_delay

parameters.help_en:
The callback reporting interval, in milliseconds. Valid values: -1 to 500.
-1: Does not accept intermediate results. Only full-sentence callbacks are accepted.
0 or not set: Reports callback results in real time.
<=500 milliseconds: Reports callback results at periodic intervals
parameters.help_zh:
回调上报间隔，单位毫秒，取值范围：-1~500毫秒。
-1：不接受中间结果，只接受整句回调。
0或不设置：实时上报回调结果。
<=500毫秒：周期性间隔上报回调结果
parameters.name: report_interval

Description.description_en: The result description. The value success indicates a successful operation. An error message is returned if a fault occurs
Description.description_zh: 结果描述，为success时成功，有错误信息则返回

RetCode.description_en: The status code. A value of 2000 indicates success. Other values indicate exceptions
RetCode.description_zh: 状态码。返回2000表示成功，返回其他表示异常
